title: Full-stack Developer (C#/.NET)
description:
Join our team as a Full-stack Developer and become a part of an exciting project focused on high-quality software development!

Our client is a proven Nordic alarm and event handling software company specializing in Personal Care, Personal Security, and IoT. We are looking for a skilled Full-stack Developer passionate about building reliable, scalable software solutions. If you enjoy working with modern technologies, solving complex integration challenges, and taking ownership of your work, this role is for you!
In this role, you will collaborate directly with the development team on the client’s side, actively participating in all phases of the software development lifecycle.

What you'll do in this role
Develop and maintain full-stack applications using C#/.NET and React
Design and implement scalable cloud-native solutions on AWS
Build new features and improve existing functionality across the platform
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers in an agile environment
Optimize application performance, reliability, and security
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code
Contribute to architecture discussions and technical decisions
Explore and leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity

We're looking for
4+ years of commercial experience with C#/.NET
Hands-on experience with React
Experience working with AWS and cloud-based applications
Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
Understanding of modern software engineering practices and Agile development
Upper-Intermediate or higher English level

How to knock our socks off
Experience with Python
Background in IoT, Smart Buildings, healthcare technology, or alarm/event management systems
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
Product mindset and a proactive approach to solving complex technical challenges
Naming five or more dishes that include beetroot besides borshch!

✔ Not checking every box?

This job looks very exciting, but you hesitate to apply because of the confidence gap? Reach out to us anyway! Beetroot is an inclusive workplace that considers all applicants. We’re committed to openness — promoting equality and fostering an environment where different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences are not just accepted, but embraced. So let’s discover together whether we could be an excellent fit for each other.
Please send us your CV in English, and we’ll be happy to discuss your application further.
